|game_text=Deploy on table. [[A Jedi's Resilience]] may not be played during move phases. [[The Circle Is Now Complete]] or [[Vader's Obsession]] may be played during any move phase to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Vader present with specified target, each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1); add ability. Loser (lower total) is lost, losing player loses 2 Force, and winning player may retrieve 2 Force.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Epic Duel (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 6 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image shown here both print this text.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Deploy on table. A Jedi's Resilience may not be played during move phases. The Circle Is Now Complete or Vader's Obsession may be played during any move phase to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Vader present with specified target, each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1); add ability. Loser (lower total) is lost, losing player loses 2 Force, and winning player may retrieve 2 Force.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Epic Duel (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Epic Duel (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “(lower total)” to “(lowest total)”: “Deploy on table. A Jedi's Resilience may not be played during move phases. The Circle Is Now Complete or Vader's Obsession may be played during any move phase to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Vader present with specified target, each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1); add ability. Loser (lowest total) is lost, losing player loses 2 Force, and winning player may retrieve 2 Force.”.<ref name="cl-1261_39-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
